exercises.title: Irregular Verbs — Recupera
exercises.description: Impara a recuperare le forme irregolari più frequenti e a distinguere Past Simple e past participle dal contesto grammaticale.
exercises.instructions: Non memorizzare una lista infinita: usa famiglie di forma, verbi ad alta frequenza e frasi reali.

sections.title: Tre forme, funzioni diverse
sections.instructions: Prima identifica quale forma serve; poi recupera il verbo corretto.

questions.title: Irregular verbs: memorizza meglio, non di più
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Osserva come il contesto ti dice se serve Past Simple o past participle.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve high-frequency irregular past and participle forms and choose the required form from grammatical context.

content.body: Molti verbi inglesi hanno una forma di Past Simple e una forma di past participle che non si costruiscono con -ed. Il contesto grammaticale ti dice quale forma serve: un evento concluso usa il Past Simple; dopo have/has serve il past participle.
content.intro: Non devi imparare cento forme in una volta. Parti dai verbi che usi davvero, raggruppa quelli che si assomigliano e recuperali dentro frasi complete.

sections.title: Perché servono tre forme
sections.body: Per ogni verbo pensa a base form, Past Simple e past participle. In questo topic il participio viene riconosciuto come forma dopo have/has; il significato del Present Perfect verrà affrontato nella lezione successiva.

sections.title: Past Simple o participle? Guarda la struttura
sections.body: La stessa radice può richiedere due forme diverse. Il tempo concluso porta il Past Simple; have/has richiede il participio.

correct.text: I saw Maya yesterday. · I have seen Maya today.

incorrect.text: I seen Maya yesterday. · I have saw Maya today.

sections.title: Famiglia 1: Past Simple = participle
sections.body: Alcuni verbi hanno la stessa seconda e terza forma. Questo riduce ciò che devi memorizzare.
sections.pattern: have → had → had · make → made → made · buy → bought → bought · tell → told → told · leave → left → left

examples.text: We made dinner. · We have made dinner before.

sections.title: Famiglia 2: participi in -en / -n
sections.body: Molti verbi frequenti hanno un participio riconoscibile in -en o -n, ma la forma va comunque memorizzata.
sections.pattern: write → wrote → written · speak → spoke → spoken · take → took → taken · give → gave → given · see → saw → seen · know → knew → known

examples.text: She wrote the email yesterday. · She has written the email.

sections.title: Famiglia 3: base form = participle
sections.body: In alcuni verbi la prima e la terza forma coincidono, mentre il Past Simple cambia.
sections.pattern: come → came → come · run → ran → run

examples.text: They came early. · They have come early before.

sections.title: Le famiglie aiutano la memoria, non creano nuove regole
sections.body: Non inventare una forma per analogia con un altro verbo: usa le famiglie per ricordare forme già apprese.

sections.title: Metodo di recupero
points: Prima identifica quale forma richiede la frase.
Past Simple: recupera la seconda forma.
Dopo have/has: recupera il past participle.
Raggruppa verbi simili, ma non inventare forme per analogia.
Ripeti le forme dentro frasi, non solo dentro tabelle.

questions.title: Quale forma serve?
questions.prompt: Yesterday we ___ to the new sports centre after school.
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma corretta di go.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve the Past Simple form of go from a finished-past context.

feedback.explanation: Yesterday richiede qui il Past Simple: go → went.

questions.title: Saw o seen? Wrote o written?
questions.prompt: Completa le frasi scegliendo la forma richiesta dalla struttura.
questions.instructions: Leggi cosa viene prima del verbo.
questions.learning_objective: Choose Past Simple or past participle forms from grammatical context.

content.text_template: 1. I [[blank_1]] the message yesterday. 2. I have [[blank_2]] the message now. 3. Sara [[blank_3]] to the teacher last night. 4. Sara has [[blank_4]] to the teacher.

feedback.explanation: Yesterday/last night → Past Simple; dopo have/has → participle.

questions.title: Recupera tre forme frequenti
questions.prompt: Completa il mini-racconto con il Past Simple.
questions.instructions: Scrivi una parola per spazio.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve three high-frequency irregular Past Simple forms in a connected context.

content.text_template: After class, we [[blank_1]] (go) to a café, [[blank_2]] (have) a snack and [[blank_3]] (see) our maths teacher there.

feedback.explanation: Go → went, have → had, see → saw.

questions.title: Il participio dopo have
questions.prompt: Correggi: I have wrote the email.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase con la forma corretta del verbo. Non devi spiegare il tempo verbale.
questions.learning_objective: Use the irregular past participle written after have.

feedback.explanation: Dopo have serve il participio: write → wrote → written.

questions.title: Recupera le forme dentro una frase
questions.prompt: Ieri abbiamo comprato il cibo e abbiamo portato tutto a casa.
questions.instructions: Traduci in inglese usando il Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Produce bought and brought accurately in a finished-past sentence.

accepted_answers: Yesterday we bought the food and brought everything home.
We bought the food yesterday and brought everything home.
Yesterday we bought food and brought everything home.
We bought food yesterday and brought everything home.

feedback.explanation: Buy → bought; bring → brought. Le due forme si assomigliano, ma vanno recuperate come verbi distinti.

exercises.title: Irregular Verbs — Allenati
exercises.description: Recupera Past Simple e participi ad alta frequenza dentro racconti, frasi, dialoghi e scelte di forma.
exercises.instructions: Identifica prima quale forma serve; poi recupera il verbo.

sections.title: Recupero attivo
sections.instructions: Le forme cambiano, ma il contesto ti dice quale colonna mentale usare.

questions.title: Un pomeriggio in città
questions.prompt: Completa il mini-racconto con il Past Simple.
questions.instructions: Scrivi una parola per spazio.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve four high-frequency irregular past forms across a connected event sequence.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] (take) the bus into town, [[blank_2]] (meet) Luca, [[blank_3]] (eat) at a small restaurant and [[blank_4]] (come) home late.

feedback.explanation: Take → took, meet → met, eat → ate, come → came.

questions.title: Past o participle?
questions.prompt: Completa le coppie scegliendo la forma richiesta.
questions.instructions: Osserva se il verbo è solo nel passato o se viene dopo have/has.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish irregular Past Simple and past participle forms for take and give.

content.text_template: 1. Yesterday Sara [[blank_1]] my book. 2. Sara has [[blank_2]] my book to Marco. 3. I [[blank_3]] him the notes yesterday. 4. I have [[blank_4]] him the notes already.

feedback.explanation: Past Simple: took/gave. Dopo has/have: taken/given. Nella seconda frase il verbo richiesto è give, non take.

questions.title: Forma sbagliata dopo has
questions.prompt: Correggi: My brother has went home.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase con la forma corretta del verbo.
questions.learning_objective: Use gone rather than went after has.

feedback.explanation: Go → went → gone. Dopo has serve gone.

questions.title: Quale famiglia ti aiuta?
questions.prompt: Which set has the same Past Simple and past participle form?
questions.instructions: Scegli una risposta.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a useful irregular-verb form family.

feedback.explanation: Made è sia Past Simple sia past participle.

questions.title: Racconta cosa hai fatto ieri
questions.prompt: Ieri ho scritto a Sara e le ho detto la verità.
questions.instructions: Traduci in inglese usando il Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Produce wrote and told naturally in a finished-past sentence.

accepted_answers: Yesterday I wrote to Sara and told her the truth.
I wrote to Sara yesterday and told her the truth.
Yesterday I wrote Sara a message and told her the truth.
I wrote Sara a message yesterday and told her the truth.

feedback.explanation: Write → wrote; tell → told.

questions.title: Quali triple sono corrette?
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le sequenze base → Past Simple → past participle corrette.
questions.instructions: Può esserci più di una risposta.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise accurate high-frequency irregular verb triples.

feedback.explanation: Know–knew–known e drink–drank–drunk sono corrette; run → ran → run; see → saw → seen.

questions.title: Participi in una checklist
questions.prompt: Completa con il past participle dei verbi tra parentesi.
questions.instructions: Dopo have/has scrivi la terza forma.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve taken, done and known as high-frequency past participles.

content.text_template: We have [[blank_1]] (take) the photos, Marco has [[blank_2]] (do) the booking, and I have [[blank_3]] (know) about the change since this morning.

feedback.explanation: Take → taken; do → done; know → known. Qui stiamo allenando la forma del participio, non ancora gli usi del tempo verbale.

questions.title: Un weekend da raccontare
questions.prompt: Scegli la risposta corretta nel dialogo.
questions.instructions: Recupera le forme dal contesto passato.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve irregular past forms naturally in a short dialogue.

turns.speaker: Luca
turns.text: Really good. I went to Verona with my cousins.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Nice! What did you do there?

options.text: We saw the centre and ate at a small restaurant.
We seen the centre and eaten at a small restaurant.
We seed the centre and eated at a small restaurant.

feedback.explanation: Nel racconto al Past Simple: see → saw, eat → ate.

exercises.title: Irregular Verbs — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica le forme irregolari in formati tipici di verifica: testo, tabella, correzione, traduzione e scelta di forma.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto prima di vedere il feedback.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Put the verbs in brackets into the Past Simple.
questions.instructions: Scrivi una parola per spazio.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve several high-frequency irregular past forms in a school-style connected text.

content.text_template: Last Saturday we [[blank_1]] (go) to a market, [[blank_2]] (find) an old book, [[blank_3]] (buy) it and then [[blank_4]] (meet) some friends for lunch.

feedback.explanation: Go → went, find → found, buy → bought, meet → met.

questions.title: Complete the verb table
questions.prompt: Complete only the missing forms.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma richiesta.
questions.learning_objective: Recall selected base, past and participle forms in a concise school-style table task.

content.text_template: write → [[blank_1]] → written · take → took → [[blank_2]] · [[blank_3]] → gave → given · run → [[blank_4]] → run

feedback.explanation: Write–wrote–written; take–took–taken; give–gave–given; run–ran–run.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: She has spoke to the teacher.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase con la forma corretta del verbo.
questions.learning_objective: Correct an irregular past form used where a participle is required.

accepted_answers: She has spoken to the teacher.

feedback.explanation: Speak → spoke → spoken; dopo has serve spoken.

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Ieri ho incontrato Paolo e gli ho dato il tuo libro.
questions.instructions: Traduci in inglese usando il Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Produce met and gave accurately in a contextual translation.

accepted_answers: Yesterday I met Paolo and gave him your book.
I met Paolo yesterday and gave him your book.

feedback.explanation: Meet → met; give → gave.

questions.title: Choose the correct form
questions.prompt: We have ___ this restaurant before.
questions.instructions: Choose the correct form of eat.
questions.learning_objective: Choose eaten as the irregular participle after have.

feedback.explanation: Eat → ate → eaten; dopo have serve eaten.

questions.title: Past Simple or past participle
questions.prompt: Complete the sentences with the correct form.
questions.instructions: Scegli tra la seconda e la terza forma.
questions.learning_objective: Choose between irregular Past Simple and participle forms from clear grammatical cues.

content.text_template: 1. I [[blank_1]] the answer yesterday. 2. I have [[blank_2]] the answer for hours. 3. She [[blank_3]] the keys this morning. 4. She has [[blank_4]] the keys now.

feedback.explanation: Know → knew → known; find → found → found.

exercises.title: Irregular Verbs — Mini-verifica
exercises.description: Verifica se recuperi autonomamente le forme irregolari frequenti e distingui Past Simple e participio dalla struttura della frase.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Obiettivo consigliato: almeno 80%.

questions.title: Una serata fuori
questions.prompt: Completa con il Past Simple.
questions.instructions: Scrivi una parola per spazio.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve three distinct irregular past forms in a connected context.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] (meet) at seven, [[blank_2]] (drink) something and [[blank_3]] (leave) before ten.

feedback.explanation: Meet → met; drink → drank; leave → left.

questions.title: Recupera i participi
questions.prompt: Completa con il past participle.
questions.instructions: Dopo have/has scrivi la terza forma.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve three high-frequency irregular past participles independently.

content.text_template: I have [[blank_1]] (write) the message, Sara has [[blank_2]] (see) it, and we have [[blank_3]] (do) everything we need.

feedback.explanation: Write → written; see → seen; do → done.

questions.title: Past o participle?
questions.prompt: Yesterday I ___ Anna at the station.
questions.instructions: Choose the correct form of see.
questions.learning_objective: Choose saw rather than seen in a finished-past context.

feedback.explanation: Yesterday + verbo senza have/has → Past Simple: saw.

questions.title: Correggi la forma
questions.prompt: Correggi: We have took the wrong bus.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Correct took to taken after have.

accepted_answers: We have taken the wrong bus.

feedback.explanation: Take → took → taken; dopo have serve taken.

questions.title: Produzione contestuale
questions.prompt: Ieri ho trovato le chiavi e le ho date a mia madre.
questions.instructions: Traduci in inglese usando il Past Simple.
questions.learning_objective: Produce found and gave accurately in a natural finished-past sentence.

accepted_answers: Yesterday I found the keys and gave them to my mother.
I found the keys yesterday and gave them to my mother.
Yesterday I found the keys and gave them to my mum.
I found the keys yesterday and gave them to my mum.
Yesterday I found the keys and gave them to my mom.
I found the keys yesterday and gave them to my mom.

feedback.explanation: Find → found; give → gave.

questions.title: Controlla le triple
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le sequenze corrette.
questions.instructions: Valuta base form, Past Simple e participle.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise accurate irregular triples across different form families.

feedback.explanation: Come–came–come e think–thought–thought sono corrette; give–gave–given; run–ran–run.

questions.title: Scegli la colonna giusta
questions.prompt: Completa le frasi con la forma corretta.
questions.instructions: Decidi dalla struttura se serve Past Simple o participle.
questions.learning_objective: Choose past or participle forms for know and speak from grammatical context.

content.text_template: 1. I [[blank_1]] the answer yesterday. 2. I have [[blank_2]] the answer for a while. 3. She [[blank_3]] to Marco last night. 4. She has [[blank_4]] to Marco.

feedback.explanation: Knew/spoke sono Past Simple; known/spoken sono participi.

questions.title: Ultimo recupero in contesto
questions.prompt: Scegli la risposta corretta.
questions.instructions: Recupera le forme dal racconto.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve high-frequency irregular past forms naturally in a final dialogue context.

content.scenario: Two friends discuss yesterday's school event.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Did you enjoy the school event yesterday?

options.text: We had lunch, then I met some students from another class and we spoke for a while.
We have lunch, then I meet some students and we speak for a while.
We had lunch, then I met some students and we spoken for a while.

feedback.explanation: Nel racconto concluso: have → had, meet → met, speak → spoke.
